notes: Portrait sheet (HEIGHT AND BULK DISTRICTS, SHEET 4H, June 1990). A single heavy frame rule (~11 px) on the left, top and right; the outline sits ~1.5 px inside each rule's inner edge (README rule 1). The page is turned slightly: the left rule drifts from x ~73 at the top to ~85 at the bottom and the right from ~3210 to ~3228. Bottom: just above the top edge of the thick bar (~26 px) that rules off the legend strip and, below it, the ZONING MAP OF THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO title strip, both inside the frame and spanning its full width (rule 3: a full-width notch, so the bottom side is the bar's top edge, y ~4044 at the left, ~4027 at the right). Sides measured column/row by column/row, smoothed, corners where the fitted sides meet. No remove polygons: north arrow, scale and SHEET 4H are in the legend strip. 'SEE SHEET 3H' (vertical, by the right rule) and 'SEE SHEET 5H' are cross-references (inside). No map ink touches the frame. No ink under the outline.
